name: The Immaculate Conception
history: The Church teaches that Mary, by a singular grace of God and in view of the merits of Christ, was preserved free from all stain of original sin from the first moment of her conception. Pius IX defined the dogma in 1854; four years later Our Lady told Bernadette at Lourdes, 'I am the Immaculate Conception.'
prayer: O Mary, conceived without sin, pray for us who have recourse to thee.
meditation: Tota pulchra es, Maria. Ask her to help you hate one particular sin.
